verdict.rationale: Cline documents its own ability to run commands, tests and dev servers in the terminal and react to their output live. That supports reproducing issues and verifying fixes, and the CLI shows a "run tests and fix failures" workflow. For root-cause narrowing, Plan mode and subagents can read and search the codebase, but no documentation describes a dedicated debugging or root-cause workflow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a root-cause or debugging workflow, documented issue-reproduction guidance, hands-on or independent corroboration of debugging effectiveness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes

citations.quote: Executes in your terminal and reacts to output as it appears. Long-running dev servers, tests, deploys, all handled live.
It can read and write files, run terminal commands, use a browser, and help you build features through natural conversation.
In this mode, Cline can read your codebase, run searches, and discuss strategy
Each subagent gets its own prompt and context window, explores the codebase independently, and returns a detailed report to the main agent.
Coordinated multi-file changes with linter-aware fixes, diffs, checkpoints, and one-click undo on every step.
